content: Korean search normalization: NFC keeps precomposed Hangul syllables (U+AC00), NFD decomposes to jamo (U+1100 U+1161) - a bigram tokenizer over NFD text produces jamo bigrams, totally different index. macOS filenames and some upload paths emit NFD. Elasticsearch default is NFKC + case folding. Full-width ASCII (A U+FF21) produced by Korean/Japanese IMEs is a distinct codepoint from half-width A; if NFKC is applied at index time but only NFC at query time, queries silently miss. Korean is morpheme-based with attached particles (조사) - bigram indexing handles this better than whitespace splitting but generates high-frequency noise bigrams from particles.
